_comment: Reviewed Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks equipment gates: the curated layer (spec 11.2, order 4).
Read once from the jar at rule-build time, NOT through the datapack reload: this is a built-in
profile, and a pack that wants a different number writes an ordinary lock rule, which outranks
everything here. Values are Magic requirements at the reference cap of 32 and multiplier 1.
Intelligence is derived at the shared 0.6 ratio, so it is not repeated per row.
Only rows verified against the irons_spellbooks 1.20.1-3.16.3 artifact ship here. The books
left out are not oversights: they are the ones whose proposed numbers the artifact contradicted,
or that no proposal covered. They get IronsBookGateMath's metadata profile, computed from the
same slot and modifier counts the reasons below cite. Deliberately absent, with why:
wimpy_spell_book        - 0 slots and no modifiers. Nothing to gate; a requirement would be
decorative. Falls out of the metadata profile as inert.
legendary_spell_book    - 12 slots but NO attribute modifiers, not fire resistant, and no
recipe or loot entry in 3.16.3: unobtainable in survival and
stat-inferior to ice/netherite. The proposed 18 ranked it on its name.
rotten_spell_book       - 8 slots, SPELL_RESIST +100. The proposal priced the resistance as a
drawback; in 3.16.3 it is an upside. It is also an ingredient of the
druidic book, so gating it gates druidic's recipe.
dragonskin_spell_book  - SHIPS, but at ice's value rather than the proposed 26. See its row.
The proposal ranked a sidegrade as an upgrade over ice; the
artifact shows one chassis with a different school attached.
evoker_spell_book       - 7 total slots of which only 4 are free. The proposed 22 read the
constructor's capacity and ignored the locked preset spells.
necronomicon_spell_book - 6 total / 2 free, dead king loot. No proposal covered it.
cursed_doll_spell_book  - 10 slots and 3 modifiers. No proposal covered it.

profiles.reason: 5 slots, no attribute modifiers, crafted from copper ingots + string + paper. The entry-level chassis and the anchor the other rows are ranked against.
6 slots, no attribute modifiers, crafted from chains + leather + paper. One clear step above copper on capacity alone.
8 slots, +50 max mana and +15% cast time, crafted from arcane essence + hogskin. First book with attributes, and the cast-time cost is why it does not outrank diamond.
10 slots and +100 max mana, crafted from diamond + enchanted book + magic cloth + hogskin. Drops gold's cast-time penalty and adds two slots: a verified upgrade, so a clear step up.
10 slots, fire spell power +0.1 and +200 max mana. A full school package; obtained from a 1% blaze drop, which is early for the power it carries but is a drop rate rather than a progression step.
10 slots, nature spell power +0.1 and +200 max mana: the same chassis as blaze with a different school, so deliberately the same requirement rather than an invented ranking between two sidegrades.
10 slots, holy spell power +0.1, cast time +0.1 and +200 max mana. Three modifiers on a diamond-sized chassis, acquired by priest trade.
12 slots, +20% cooldown reduction and +200 max mana, crafted from netherite + ruined book + blood vial + lightning bottle. Late-game acquisition and a general-purpose benefit rather than one school.
12 slots, ice spell power +0.1 and +200 max mana, crafted from mithril scrap + three ice venom vials + a ruined book. The most demanding acquisition chain of the verified books.

12 slots, ender spell power +0.1 and +200 max mana, crafted from six dragonskin + obsidian + a ruined book. Byte-for-byte the ice spellbook's chassis and stat package with a different school, so it is ranked EQUAL to ice rather than above it. The proposed 26 treated a verified sidegrade as an upgrade; shipping it as a metadata profile instead would have split one sidegrade pair across two layers and produced two different numbers for the same item.
